summary: "History of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, Volume 2" is a historical work published between 1902-1912. This volume covers January 1834 through December 1837 of Joseph Smith's life and the early Latter Day Saint movement. Based on Smith's writings and his scribes' accounts, the text was extensively revised by B. H. Roberts, who added commentary and corrected errors from the original manuscript. The work chronicles a pivotal period in Mormon history through firsthand accounts and editorial interpretation. (This is an automatically generated summary.)
